services.desc: Renting a boat at Volunteer Landing Marina is the perfect way to experience Knoxville’s waterfront from a whole new perspective. Located right in the heart of downtown, Volunteer Landing provides easy access to the beautiful Tennessee River, giving you miles of scenic shoreline and wide-open water to explore. Each of our rental boats is designed to make your adventure effortless-featuring spacious seating, smooth handling, and all the essentials you need for a safe and enjoyable ride. Grab your friends, pack your cooler, and set off for a day of sightseeing, swimming, or simply soaking up the peaceful river views. Must be 21 years of age.
